name: wod20th
title: World of Darkness 20th Edition
author: SamDev
description: World of Darkness 20th Anniversary Edition ruleset for Loom VTT (Storyteller System): d10 dice pools against a difficulty, character sheets for Vampire, Werewolf, Mage, Hunter and Mortals, and a universal item sheet. Unofficial, free and non-commercial fan project.
